Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
🚀 Join an international team and help build, automate and scale a modern cloud platform used in a complex enterprise environment.
 We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer passionate about automation, cloud technologies and platform engineering. You will work closely with developers, operations teams and architects to improve infrastructure, enhance developer experience and support cloud adoption initiatives.
 What you'll be doing: 
Design and improve CI/CD pipelines and automation processes
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions
Support cloud migration and hybrid-cloud initiatives
Manage and optimize containerized environments and Kubernetes platforms
Implement monitoring, logging and alerting solutions
Collaborate with development and operations teams to troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues
Contribute to the evolution of the platform and operational best practices
 What we're looking for: 
 ✔ Strong DevOps and platform engineering experience
 ✔ Hands-on expertise with Linux, shell scripting and automation
 ✔ Experience with Kubernetes, containers and related tools (Helm, Grafana)
 ✔ Strong knowledge of Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code solutions
 ✔ Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, TeamCity or GitHub Actions
 ✔ Cloud experience, ideally with GCP
 ✔ Working knowledge of Python and/or JVM-based languages
 ➕ Experience with Kafka, Airflow, Spark, OpenShift or hybrid cloud environments is a plus.
 📍 Hybrid working model
 🌍 International project environment
 📈 Opportunity to work on large-scale cloud and platform transformation initiatives
